name: No Visa Required (NVR) for Persons of Bangladeshi Origin

requirements.blocker_text: Holds (or previously held) a Bangladeshi passport, National ID card, or a 17-digit online-verifiable Bangladeshi birth certificate.
Not a national of a SAARC country (NVR does not apply to SAARC nationals).

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or child of a qualifying document holder

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse (subject to specific conditions and physical presence at the consulate) or child (with parent's name shown on the birth certificate) of a person who qualifies as a Bangladeshi-origin document holder.

evidence_required.document: Bangladeshi passport, NID, or 17-digit birth certificate (self or qualifying parent)
Proof of current country of residence

outcome.duration_length: multiple entries into Bangladesh with unlimited duration of stay, for the full validity of the holder's passport

sources.title: Consulate General of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Dubai -- No Visa Required (NVR): for foreign nationals of Bangladeshi origin (except SAARC nations), their spouses, and their children; grants multiple entries with unlimited duration of stay within the validity of the passport; applied via visa.gov.bd, processed through the local mission

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official consulate sourced. MARQUEE ANCESTRY ROUTE, GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE: this is not citizenship and not formal permanent residence -- it is an unlimited-duration, multiple-entry visa exemption endorsement, functionally equivalent to permanent free movement in and out of Bangladesh for the diaspora and their immediate family, without ever converting to a residence status or citizenship. work_rights and study_rights are marked 'full' since NVR holders face no employment/study restriction once in Bangladesh (distinct from ordinary visit visas), though this is inferred from the unrestricted nature of the endorsement rather than an explicit tier-1 statement to that effect -- flagged as an interpretation. A separate INVESTMENT-based NVR pathway also exists (US$10 million+ commitment to heavy industry, requiring BSCIC certification, per tier-3 legalseba sourcing) but was not independently tier-1 confirmed and is not modeled as a requirement group here -- disclosed only. Excludes SAARC nationals (India, Pakistan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, etc.) entirely, per the source's own explicit carve-out -- worth flagging since it means Bangladeshi-origin persons who are ALSO nationals of a SAARC country cannot use this route regardless of ancestry.
